_comment: Spec 0030. Min/max ranges from 5 baseline runs per metric. A later run falling outside [min, max] is a regression (worse) or a progression (better) worth investigating, not automatically failing the test. IMPORTANT: these numbers are from the rootable_api35 emulator (google/sdk_gphone64_x86_64), NOT the physical TECNO LI9 - the physical device hangs inside Macrobenchmark's own ProfileInstaller reset step between iterations (confirmed via logcat, not app-code bug - see spec 0030 'Результаты'). Emulator numbers validate the measurement pipeline end-to-end but are not representative of real device performance and must not be used as the real regression baseline until re-measured on TECNO LI9 (or another physical device).

compose_recomposition_layout_draw.status: Fixed via TestMessageSeeder (spec 0030 follow-up): the emulator had no real SMS history, so the conversations list was empty and the scroll produced zero frames. Seeded 30 synthetic messages (distinct senders) via `content insert` before the run - frameCount went from 1 (degenerate/failing) to 141-155 (real, reproducible scroll). Compose:recompose/Layout/Draw TraceSectionMetric still read 0 across all runs - the Compose runtime trace sections this relies on are apparently not emitted (or not named as expected) on this Compose/AGP version; open item, not caused by empty data.

jit_vs_aot.status: Not measured this session on either device - deferred, see spec 0030 'Открытые вопросы'.
